name: Canadian Grocery Restrictive Covenants Open Dataset

mentions.name: Canadian Grocery Restrictive Covenants Open Dataset
mentions.description: An open dataset of grocery restrictive covenants in Canada, described as the country's biggest collection of these land-use documents. It documents limitations placed on land that restrict what tenants can sell and prevent landlords from renting to other grocers within a radius, binding future owners in perpetuity. The dataset currently covers covenants with plans to add more from Edmonton and Halifax and to inform key people of their availability.
mentions.problem: Grocery companies use restrictive covenants on land to reduce competition, and these binding documents were not previously available in an open dataset.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've just published Canada's biggest open dataset for these covenants: https://jacobfilipp.com/covenants/
